test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: The difference between a discount of 27% and two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on a certain bill was ₹56. Find the amount of the bill.
solution:
**Given:**

Difference between a discount of 27% and two successive discounts of 20% and 10% = ₹56

**Calculation:**

Let the bill amount be ₹x.

Single discount of 27%:

Discount = 0.27x

Two successive discounts of 20% and 10%:

Effective discount = 1 - (1 - 0.20) × (1 - 0.10) = 1 - 0.80 × 0.90 = 1 - 0.72 = 0.28x

Difference between the discounts:

0.28x - 0.27x = ₹56

0.01x = ₹56

x = ₹56 / 0.01 = ₹5600

**∴ The amount of the bill is ₹5600.**
